name: Attention mechanism
description: Softmax-weighted combination of values based on query-key similarity: attn(Q,K,V) = softmax(QK^T / sqrt(d)) V. Foundation for modern Hopfield Ramsauer connection + transformer architectures.

name: Positional encoding (sinusoidal)
description: Encoding of position via sinusoids: PE(pos, 2i) = sin(pos / 10000^(2i/d)). Foundation for transformer position-awareness + substrate-relevant order encoding analogues.

name: Dropout regularization
description: Stochastic regularization: zero out random subset of activations during training. Foundation for substrate-relevant noise-based regularization analogues.

name: Batch normalization
description: Normalization layer rescaling activations to zero mean + unit variance per batch. Foundation for stable training + substrate-relevant pre-conditioning.

name: Layer normalization
description: Normalization across features within layer (per-sample). Foundation for transformer training stability + substrate-relevant per-atom normalization.

name: Adam optimizer
description: Adaptive moment estimation: per-parameter learning rate via first + second moment estimates. Foundation for modern neural net training + substrate-relevant gradient-based learning.

name: Stochastic gradient descent (SGD)
description: Per-mini-batch gradient updates: x_{k+1} = x_k - eta nabla L(batch_k). Foundation for modern ML + substrate-relevant online learning.

name: Contrastive learning (InfoNCE)
description: Self-supervised learning via positive/negative pair discrimination: maximize sim(x, x+) vs sim(x, x-). Foundation for representation learning + substrate-relevant analogues.

name: Softmax function
description: softmax(x_i) = exp(x_i) / sum exp(x_j). Foundation for classification probability outputs + attention mechanism + substrate-relevant probability normalization.

name: Cross-entropy loss
description: Loss function L = -sum y log p. Foundation for classification training + substrate-relevant log-likelihood maximization.

name: Mean squared error (MSE)
description: Loss L = (1/N) sum (y_i - y_hat_i)^2. Foundation for regression + substrate-relevant continuous-target learning.

name: K-means clustering
description: Lloyd's algorithm: iterative assignment + center update minimizing within-cluster variance. Foundation for unsupervised clustering + substrate-relevant prototype generation.

name: Hierarchical clustering
description: Agglomerative / divisive clustering producing dendrogram. Foundation for clustering + substrate-relevant prototype hierarchy.

name: Word2vec embedding
description: Distributional word embedding via skip-gram or CBOW. Foundation for distributional semantics + substrate-relevant comparison baseline.

name: GloVe embedding
description: Global vectors via co-occurrence matrix factorization. Foundation for distributional semantics + substrate-relevant semantic-vec comparison.

name: Byte-pair encoding (BPE)
description: Subword tokenization via iterative merging of frequent byte pairs. Foundation for modern LLM tokenization + substrate-relevant token-vocabulary primitive.

name: SentencePiece tokenizer
description: Language-agnostic subword tokenization via unigram model or BPE. Used in most modern LLMs.

name: LSTM cell
description: Long short-term memory recurrent cell with input/forget/output gates + cell state. Foundation for RNN sequence modeling + substrate-relevant gated recurrence.

name: Transformer block
description: Self-attention + feed-forward + residual + layer norm. Foundation for transformer architectures + substrate-relevant comparison baseline.

name: Residual / skip connection
description: Identity shortcut: y = F(x) + x. Foundation for deep residual networks + substrate-relevant gradient flow.

name: Policy gradient
description: RL policy update via gradient of expected reward: nabla J = E[nabla log pi * Q]. Foundation for REINFORCE + Actor-Critic + substrate-relevant reward-driven learning.

name: Q-learning
description: Off-policy temporal-difference RL: Q(s,a) <- Q(s,a) + alpha (r + gamma max Q(s',a') - Q(s,a)). Foundation for RL + substrate-relevant value learning.

name: Markov decision process (MDP)
description: Mathematical framework for sequential decision making: (S, A, P, R, gamma). Foundation for RL + substrate-relevant sequential decision modeling.

name: Bellman equation
description: V(s) = max_a [r(s,a) + gamma E[V(s')]] dynamic programming recursion. Foundation for optimal control + RL + substrate-relevant value iteration.

name: Cosine similarity
description: sim(u, v) = u . v / (|u| |v|). Foundation for vector similarity + substrate cleanup retrieval + semantic-vec comparison.

name: Euclidean distance
description: d(u, v) = sqrt(sum (u_i - v_i)^2). Foundation for metric retrieval + substrate-relevant distance-based cleanup.

name: Locality-sensitive hashing (LSH)
description: Hashing scheme where similar inputs likely hash to same bucket. Foundation for approximate nearest neighbor + substrate-relevant fast retrieval.

name: Random projection
description: Linear projection to lower dimension via random matrix. Foundation for dimensionality reduction + substrate-relevant codebook compression.

name: Feature hashing (hashing trick)
description: Hash-based feature encoding for high-cardinality categorical features. Foundation for substrate-relevant feature compression + count-based ML.

name: Iterative proportional fitting (IPF)
description: Iterative scaling algorithm matching marginal constraints. Foundation for contingency table fitting + substrate-relevant constrained probability.
